name: Burns Cottage
scope: The standing whitewashed and thatched Burns Cottage in Alloway, including the attached byre and barn.
era: The preserved cottage after removal of the later slate-roofed addition and with its renewed traditional reed roof.

originalReview.notes: The whitewashed crooked cottage, deep eaves, two white ridge stacks and thatch in an original photograph of the preserved building.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: The exact Qualla exterior original matches the creator’s CC0 upload. The historical illustrations have different first-publication rights and do not control this model.
